fields.title: 3. A Mirror Event in the Same Month — No One Counted SpaceX's FCC D2D Authorization (DA 26-1078, 10/6)
fields.md:
Articles on the Globalstar approval stated that "earlier this month the FCC authorized SpaceX's 15,000-satellite D2D constellation," which brought to light **SpaceX's own regulatory event** during reporting. It is **absent** from the measurement layer (filings, IR, launch monitoring — news monitoring only from 10/27) and from the 10/23 monthly round. We open the primary source after the event (the original FCC order text) and record it.

| Item | Content | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Order | **DA 26-1078 "Authorization and Order" — Space Exploration Holdings, LLC, SpaceX NGSO MSS System** (GN Docket 25-340 · SAT-LOA-20250916-00282 · SAT-AMD-20251125-00339 · call sign S00735), adopted and released **2026-10-06**, Space Bureau + Wireless Telecommunications Bureau | ① Regulator original [DA 26-1078](https://docs.fcc.gov/public/attachments/DA-26-1078A1.txt), 2026-10-06 |
| Scale | **15,000 satellites**, 9 VLEO orbital planes (26° 335km ~ 96.87° 326km) | Same |
| Granted (conditional) | SCS (Supplemental Coverage from Space, carrier-spectrum) and MSS in the US, waiver for MSS downlink at 2000–2020MHz, waiver for SCS uplink in AWS-3 unpaired (1695–1710MHz), Ka 18.6–18.8GHz downlink · V 51.4–52.4GHz uplink · W-band uplink (non-interference condition), partial EPFD waiver | Same |
| Deferred | MSS uplink at 2020–2025MHz in the US, 20.2–21.2 · 30.0–31.0GHz (federal use), wide-area D2D MSS at 1429–2690MHz outside the US | Same |
| **Key conditions** | Condition 3: 2GHz MSS/AWS-4 · AWS-H · AWS-3 bands **"no operations until the second closing of the SpaceX-EchoStar transaction"** (notice within 30 days after closing). Condition 4: before then, only non-protected, non-interfering testing with the consent of EchoStar and the trust. The second closing is **expected around 2027-11-30** (reported) | Same · ⑥ [Via Satellite 10/07](https://www.satellitetoday.com/connectivity/2026/10/07/fcc-grants-spacex-approval-for-15000-direct-to-device-satellites-in-mss-spectrum/) |
| Deadlines | Surety bond **2026-11-04** · 50% launched **2032-10-07** · all **2035-10-07** · 15-year license term (from the date the first D2D satellite reaches orbit) · period to reject the conditional grant is 30 days from release (silence = acceptance) | DA 26-1078 (above) |
| Executive remarks (candidate) | Shotwell: launches of 2nd-generation Starlink Mobile satellites to begin "next year (2027)", service at "the end of next year", "100 times more than now" — **not a basis for judgment** | Via Satellite 10/07 (above) → `musk_statements_as_milestone_candidates_only` |

**What this means for A-2028-1 ("30 million subscribers AND $3 billion in separately disclosed Starlink Mobile (D2C) revenue")**: The regulatory door has opened, but **2GHz MSS (EchoStar spectrum) operation is tied to a date after around 2027-11-30**. For $3 billion of D2C revenue to appear in the 2028 judgment year, the question is which path reaches the revenue line: ① before the end of 2027, through SCS (carrier spectrum, T-Mobile type) and overseas D2C, or ② through 2GHz MSS during 2028. This round **does not change the status** (remains in progress, same reason for non-measurability) — because there is no revenue disclosure. However, **the two additional primary-source records before 12/1** (DA 26-1078 · the EchoStar second-closing schedule) are not written into progress but attached to `open_questions` and T8 (source: `state.milestones[A-2028-1]` · table above).

**Monitoring gap record**: The 10/6 SpaceX D2D authorization is **not subject to a company 8-K and had no IR press release**, so it is the kind of event that filing and IR monitoring cannot catch. The news monitor has run since 10/27. FCC ICFS (satellite licensing system) · EDOCS are sources the measurement layer does not watch — we register it as the measurement layer's responsibility (source: `data/spacex_watch.json` events (no 10/6 entry) · `CLAUDE.md` ⑳ detection mapping table).
